title: Instance information
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Version and uptime are informational; no automatic configuration assessment is made.

title: Database inventory
permissions: Visibility of the queried metadata; results may be partial.
notes: Recovery model, owner and compatibility require context; they are not automatically classified as good or bad.

title: Database files and growth settings
permissions: Visibility of the queried metadata; results may be partial.
notes: Shows allocated size, not actual space used; FILESTREAM requires separate measurement.

title: Service status
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER SECURITY STATE (2022+).
notes: Output includes service accounts and paths from the queried server.

title: Blocked sessions and their blockers
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Includes blockers without an active request. Negative IDs have special meanings and do not represent ordinary logins.

title: Active requests
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: SQL text is optional and may contain personal data or secrets. Percent complete is available only for certain operations.

title: Resources by session
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Counters accumulate over the session; memory_usage describes session memory, not total query memory.

title: Locks in the selected database
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Preserves resource IDs without assuming every lock represents a HoBT. Negative session IDs are preserved.

title: Recorded suspect pages
permissions: SELECT on the queried msdb tables; request specific access from your DBA.
notes: An empty result does not prove database integrity; no DBCC command or repair is performed.

title: tempdb data file usage
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: The connection must use tempdb. Reserved space is not equivalent to bytes used by records.

title: Cumulative file I/O
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Counters are cumulative, not sampled over an interval. Averages do not describe the latency distribution.

title: Scheduler queues
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Snapshot of visible online schedulers; review multiple samples before concluding that they are saturated.

title: Cached procedure statistics
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: One row per cached plan. Restarts, recompilation and cache eviction change the counter window.

title: Cached trigger statistics
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Does not inventory triggers absent from the cache; no trigger is executed.

title: Cached queries by CPU usage
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Counters describe cached plans, not permanent history. SQL text may contain sensitive values and is opt-in.

title: Cached queries by logical reads
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Counters describe cached plans, not permanent history. SQL text may contain sensitive values and is opt-in.

title: Memory configuration and status
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Does not calculate an ideal value or reconfigure the instance. Some memory consumers are outside the max server memory limit.

title: Cumulative instance wait statistics
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Does not clear counters or exclude categories heuristically. Background waits may dominate the ranking.

title: Disk-based table space
permissions: VIEW DATABASE STATE and VIEW DEFINITION (2016–2019); VIEW DATABASE PERFORMANCE STATE and VIEW SECURITY DEFINITION (2022+).
notes: Approximate rows are counted only for heaps and clustered indexes; space includes indexes. Excludes memory-optimized table memory and external FILESTREAM files.

title: Index and data space inventory
permissions: Visibility of the queried metadata; results may be partial.
notes: A data space can be a filegroup or partition scheme; the query does not associate every file in a filegroup with an index.

title: Index usage counters
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: NULL means there is no DMV record, not that an index is unnecessary. Counters can reset and do not measure modified rows.

title: Missing index estimates
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Optimizer suggestions are incomplete and do not justify creating indexes automatically; no DDL is generated.

title: Statistics properties
permissions: Permission to query object metadata and statistics; see the reference.
notes: NULL may indicate a missing statistics blob or insufficient visibility; age alone does not determine whether an update is needed.

title: Latest backups by type
permissions: SELECT on the queried msdb tables; request specific access from your DBA.
notes: Local history may have been removed or may exist on another replica. Does not prove recoverability or log chain coverage.

title: Database replica status
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Visibility on a secondary replica is mainly local; an empty result does not prove health. Queue sizes are in KB and rates in KB/s.

title: Direct sysadmin members
permissions: Visibility of server principals and role memberships; see the reference.
notes: Does not expand Windows group membership or resolve each identity's effective permissions.

title: Explicit database permissions
permissions: Visibility of the queried metadata; results may be partial.
notes: Does not calculate effective permissions or role inheritance. Securable IDs are preserved for every class.

title: Potential orphaned SQL users
permissions: Full visibility of SQL Server logins and database users.
notes: Includes only INSTANCE authentication, not contained users. Partial login visibility may cause false positives.

title: Database encryption status
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER SECURITY STATE (2022+).
notes: Missing DMV keys are shown explicitly; does not export keys, password hashes or certificates.

title: Job status and latest completion
permissions: SELECT on the queried msdb tables; request specific access from your DBA.
notes: Activity comes from the most recent Agent session; it does not prove that the service is currently running.

title: Job completion history
permissions: SELECT on the queried msdb tables; request specific access from your DBA.
notes: Duration is calculated numerically, including runs longer than 24 hours. Dates use local times recorded by Agent; error messages are not included.

title: Pagination with deterministic ordering
permissions: Database connection; uses synthetic values only.
notes: A tie-breaker avoids ambiguous ordering. Concurrent production data requires its own consistency strategy.

title: Distribution and percentile ranking
permissions: Database connection; uses synthetic values only.
notes: PERCENT_RANK and CUME_DIST handle ties differently; no permanent table is created.

title: NULL predicates
permissions: Database connection; uses synthetic values only.
notes: Uses IS NULL and IS NOT NULL; does not disable ANSI_NULLS or require a sample database table.

title: CLR assemblies and bound modules
permissions: Metadata visibility in the selected database; VIEW DEFINITION for complete visible definitions.
notes: Does not execute CLR, export DLLs or classify assemblies as malicious. Permission set is a declared property, not proof of safety. Names and optional hashes are environment-specific; current owner is not the creator.
mode: read-only; SET/DECLARE affect only the session or batch.

title: Modules matching a review term
permissions: Metadata visibility in the selected database; VIEW DEFINITION for complete visible definitions.
notes: Set an exact text fragment before use. Matches include comments and are review candidates, not proof of malicious behavior. Definitions stay hidden unless explicitly enabled and may contain secrets. Encrypted or invisible definitions cannot be searched.
mode: read-only; SET/DECLARE affect only the session or batch.

title: Existing audit, trace and Extended Events sources
permissions: Server audit metadata visibility, ALTER TRACE for traces, and VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Inventories existing sources without enabling collection. Current configuration cannot establish what was captured previously. Paths are hidden by default. Does not read event payloads or credentials.
mode: read-only; SET/DECLARE affect only the session or batch.

title: Current SQL login password-change metadata
permissions: Visibility of the selected login and permissions required by LOGINPROPERTY.
notes: Requires an explicit login name. Does not select passwords, hashes or SIDs. PasswordLastSetTime is current-state metadata; it does not identify the person who changed a password or recover prior changes.
mode: read-only; SET/DECLARE affect only the session or batch.

title: Object events in existing default trace files
permissions: ALTER TRACE; visibility of sys.traces.
notes: Legacy trace reader; does not enable tracing. Set a database and start time in server-local time. Rollover retention is limited and timestamps do not identify a person. Identity fields are opt-in; SQL text is never selected.
mode: read-only; SET/DECLARE affect only the session or batch.

title: Authentication of the current connection
permissions: Permission to inspect the current session in sys.dm_exec_connections; VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Reports this connection only. KERBEROS here does not validate another application connection or prove that every SPN is correct. Login names and network addresses are not selected.
mode: read-only; SET/DECLARE affect only the session or batch.

title: SQL Agent job and step metadata
permissions: Appropriate SQL Agent role and visibility of msdb job metadata.
notes: Does not run or change jobs. Step commands and output paths are hidden by default and may contain credentials when enabled. Job ownership is not creation authorship.
mode: read-only; SET/DECLARE affect only the session or batch.

title: Automatic seeding attempts and transfer progress
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Collect separately on source and destination. Failure descriptions need correlation with existing error logs. Empty transfer rows can mean completed, failed or inactive seeding; they do not prove health.
mode: read-only; SET/DECLARE affect only the session or batch.

title: Local replica and database failover indicators
context: master on the intended WSFC secondary replica
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Snapshot only, not authorization or a guarantee of safe failover. Missing or NULL database state must not be treated as ready. Check both replicas, quorum and the full database list before any planned operation.
mode: read-only; SET/DECLARE affect only the session or batch.

title: Availability group listeners and endpoint configuration
context: master on an Always On instance
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+). Endpoint metadata also requires VIEW SERVER SECURITY STATE on SQL Server 2022+.
notes: Returns configured listener/endpoint names and ports, not a connectivity or SPN test. Network names and optional addresses are environment data; do not publish results unchanged.
mode: read-only; SET/DECLARE affect only the session or batch.

title: Generate a SQL Agent job state command
permissions: Visibility of the selected msdb job; generated commands require permission to update the destination job.
notes: Set one exact job name and desired state. Job must already exist on the destination. Enabling does not enable schedules or check primary-replica ownership; review duplicate execution risk. Names are escaped as Unicode literals.
mode: generator only; returns command text and never executes it.

title: Generate an enable or disable command for one trigger
permissions: Metadata visibility in the selected database; VIEW DEFINITION for complete visible definitions. Generated commands require ALTER on the parent object or the applicable DDL-trigger permission.
notes: Set trigger scope and exact name; set schema for object-scoped triggers. Default action is DISABLE. No DROP commands are generated. Parent objects are quoted independently; database/server scopes are not interchangeable.
mode: generator only; returns command text and never executes it.

title: Generate a scoped EXECUTE grant
permissions: Metadata visibility in the selected database; VIEW DEFINITION for complete visible definitions. Executing the generated GRANT requires grant authority on the chosen securable.
notes: Requires an existing principal and an explicit object/schema/database scope. Object is the default. Schema/database grants include future executable objects; no users or roles are created and no server-wide EXECUTE grant is assumed.
mode: generator only; returns command text and never executes it.

title: Generate a planned WSFC availability group failover command
context: master on the intended secondary replica
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+). Executing generated text requires ALTER AVAILABILITY GROUP or equivalent authority.
notes: Requires one exact group and passing visible local database indicators. Recheck both replicas, synchronous mode, quorum and all databases immediately before execution. Snapshot can become stale; no forced/data-loss failover is generated.
mode: generator only; returns command text and never executes it.

title: Generate automatic seeding commands for an existing replica
context: master on the current primary replica
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+). Generated commands require availability group administration permissions.
notes: Requires exact group and existing target-replica names. Does not add replicas, change endpoints or select synchronous mode. Review capacity, paths, database containment settings, endpoint connectivity and target identity before separately executing either output.
mode: generator only; returns command text and never executes it.

title: Programmable objects across visible databases
context: master; fresh session with no open transaction
permissions: VIEW ANY DATABASE and metadata visibility in each database; VIEW DEFINITION for definitions; server trigger metadata permissions. Partial visibility remains possible.
notes: Includes triggers, procedures and functions without executing discovered objects. Set ObjectCategory to TRIGGER for a trigger inventory. Reports skipped databases and errors separately. Definitions are hidden by default; owners and modification dates do not identify the creator or last execution.
mode: metadata reads with session-local temporary tables and parameterized dynamic SQL; no persistent changes.
